text_block_list.text:
Каррен Тян runs well in the Ocean
Stakes, and
the response to her Cutie ♪
Derby is also
excellent.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, her next opponent, Biko
Pegasus,
boasts far more popularity than
her on UmaTok.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It seems Каррен Тян has a secret plan,
though
she keeps it to herself as we
proceed to the first
round of the
Cutie ♪ Derby—the
Takamatsunomiya
Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
